highlights.title: Fix mmol/L rounding on Nightscout import
changes: Imported mmol/L settings no longer get bumped up by 0.1 during onboarding.
ISF and blood glucose target values imported from Nightscout now match the displayed picker values.
Imports already in mg/dL are not altered by this change.

highlights.title: DanaKit update: manual temp basal and fixes
changes: A Manual Temp Basal option was added to the app.
A Travel Lock feature was added.
Temporary Basal Rates (TBR) no longer disappear during data sync.
Navigation titles in the app were corrected.
The update includes fixes for deadlocks to improve app stability.

highlights.title: Fix field navigation order in Treatments screen
changes: Up/down keyboard arrows now move between Fat, Protein, Carbs, and Bolus in the correct order.
The Fat and Protein fields are no longer swapped when moving focus with the arrow buttons.
This fixes navigation on the Treatments entry screen when using the keyboard's up/down buttons.

includedPullRequests.title: Fix mmol/L rounding when importing a Nightscout profile during onboarding
includedPullRequests.body:
Importing a Nightscout profile in mmol/L during onboarding shifts some values up by 0.1, for example an ISF of 5.6 is imported and shown as 5.7. Fixes #1179.

The cause is correctUnitParsingOffsets, which rounds odd mg/dL values up to the next even number after the mmol/L conversion. It dates from the old settings import, where the mmol picker only contained even mg/dL values and imported values were matched exactly, so odd values had to be moved onto the even grid. The current picker contains one value per 0.1 mmol step and the import picks the closest value, so the converted value already lands on the right step and the bump just moves it into the next one.

includedPullRequests.title: Update TreatmentsRootView.swift to fix wrong field order
includedPullRequests.body:
It looks like some point in the past, the fat and protein field got exchanged. However, their order appears to be wrong. As a result, when using the UP ^ and DOWN arrow buttons that now appear with Liquid Glass (next to the trashcan) when you have the keyboard open: they return to the wrong fields. When you tap "up" on fat, it goes to protein to the right, and "up" on protein returns to Carbs instead of to the Fat field to the left. 

In other words the order defined in previousField and nextField appears to be incorrect. This commit re-orders them so the up and down arrows (and any other scenario wherein the order matters) should be fixed. (Works for me on iOS 26 and fixes the observed wrong order. Not tested on iOS 27.)
